failureMessage: El asesor está fuera de su alcance activo.
rootCause: The canonical Ops/Leads workflow backend applied Leads scope to every negocios mutation and then applied a second generic scope check. That blocks a legitimate Ops-to-advisor typed handoff for a business assigned to another advisor even when the authenticated active role has an authorized operational scope. R20 requires Leads OWN by commercial identity while Ops uses an independent configured scope.

authority.invariant: Leads remains OWN by commercial identity even with privileged active role; Ops scope is independent. Cross-domain collaboration is allowed only as a typed handoff, not as general Leads access.

behavior: Normal negocios writes continue to authorize against Leads scope.

A new typed direction=advisor collaboration may use Ops scope only for update_business, only for an operational-context business, and only when the authenticated active role is an authorized Ops/Admin role.
Advisor direction=operations responses continue to authorize against Leads OWN.
The second scope check uses the same adjudicated domain instead of intersecting Leads and Ops implicitly.
